name: Merge
description: Merges a pull/merge request once a human opts it in: label it "conduit-merge", then mark it ready for review — on this workflow, labeled + ready means "merge it". Checks must be green. Minor mechanical conflicts are resolved automatically; semantic conflicts are escalated by converting the PR/MR back to draft with an analysis comment (re-marking ready retries). Closes the linked issue after merging. Pairs with the Develop and Review templates as the final stage of a board-driven pipeline, or runs standalone.

workflows.name: Merge
workflows.description: Polling on label=conduit-merge AND pr_state=ready_for_review. Merger verifies CI, merges clean or mechanically-resolvable pull/merge requests into their base branch, closes the linked issue, and converts semantic conflicts back to draft for a human to decide.

nodes.name: Merger
nodes.instructionsAppend: If you escalate or block, your comment must mention that this workflow re-runs when the pull/merge request transitions from draft to ready for review with the "conduit-merge" label still applied.
